lines.en: Did you watch the news this morning?
Yes. This morning there was a report about the park.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 공원에 관한 보도가 있었어요.

lines.en: I read that article in the newspaper yesterday.
lines.ko: 저는 어제 신문에서 그 기사를 읽었어요.

lines.en: The public event is going to be next Sunday.
lines.ko: 대중 행사는 다음 주 일요일에 열릴 거예요.

lines.en: Will they show it live on television?
Yes, on channel seven. The program starts at ten.
lines.ko: 네, 7번 채널에서요. 프로그램은 열 시에 시작해요.

lines.en: Let's go there together. It will be fun.
Good idea. Which radio program do you like now?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 요즘 어떤 라디오 프로그램을 좋아해요?

lines.en: I like the morning music program on the radio.
Me too. Let's listen to it after breakfast.
Hi! Do you listen to the radio?
Yes, every evening. Why do you ask?
I want a good program for learning English.
Channel three has a live English program at seven.
lines.ko: 3번 채널에 일곱 시 생방송 영어 프로그램이 있어요.

lines.en: Is it a news program?
No, it's an easy talk program for the public.
lines.ko: 아니요, 대중을 위한 쉬운 대화 프로그램이에요.

lines.en: I listened to the news yesterday, but it was fast.
This one is slow and clear. You will like it.
Thank you. I will listen to it tonight.
Tell me about it tomorrow. Have a good evening!
lines.ko: 내일 어땠는지 말해 주세요. 좋은 저녁 보내세요!
